---

I've added a debug mode feature to the API client. Here's how to use it:

1. To enable debug logging, call:
```typescript
apiClient.setDebugMode(true);
```

2. To disable debug logging, call:
```typescript
apiClient.setDebugMode(false);
```

When debug mode is enabled, every API request and response will be logged to the console with the following format:

For requests:
```
[API Request] METHOD /path { data: ... }  // if there's request data
[API Request] METHOD /path                // if there's no request data
```

For responses:
```
[API Response] METHOD /path { ok: true, data: ... }  // for successful responses
[API Response] METHOD /path { ok: false, error: ... }  // for error responses
```

The logging is non-intrusive and only happens when debug mode is explicitly enabled. This will help you track all API interactions during debugging without affecting production behavior.
